2921-6277-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

640-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

967-3809-4247-6753-7087.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4050-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4050-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

489-4200-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

206-1270-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three creature tokens
Activate two tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

997-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

486-1978-6479.description:
Cause Rainveil Rejuvenator to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat from step 2.

141-3495-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-5231.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-5231.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

1563-3197-4321-6934.description:
Activate Greta by paying {G} and sacrificing a Food, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

972-3277-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-3277-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch and the Palinchron token.
When the Izzet Chronarch and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-3277-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Izzet Chronarch instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

1844-5147-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-5147-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2267-5776-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1737-2793-6798.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by acrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat each turn.

628-2292-6487.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Viscera Seer ability, and repeat from step 1.

413-826-1636-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
413-826-1636-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station triggers, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.

457-5491-6263.description:
Cast Worldwalker Helm by paying {2}{U}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Worldwalker Helm spell.
Resolve both Worldwalker Helm spells.
Activate Urza by tapping a Worldwalker Helm, adding {U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus an additional Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza twice by tapping two Map tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 5.
457-5491-6263.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Urza's ability to cast your library.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

81-2060-3574-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
Freed from the Real attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness and has a power of at least two.
81-2060-3574-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.
81-2060-3574-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

1003-2921-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

283-3263-3581-3996.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Twilight Drover.
Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
283-3263-3581-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Illusionists's Bracers triggers, copying Twilight Drover's ability.
Resolve both Twilight Drover abilities, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Kykar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {3}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

797-2034-2634-4783.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying {4}{U}{U}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Stolen Identity.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Stolen Identity, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1840-3179-3676-4770.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}, drawing you a card.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {W}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
